title: Vyshka action envelope bodies
description: Machine-readable companion to spec/protocol.md section 7. The prose document is normative: where the two disagree, the prose wins. Like the other schema documents this is a library of definitions with no root constraint: reference `#/$defs/actionDispatch`, `#/$defs/actionAck`, and `#/$defs/actionResult` for the three envelope bodies of the action lifecycle.

actionId.description: Hub-assigned, opaque to clients and plugins. The plugin's dedup key: an actionId must never execute twice.

actionDispatch.title: action.dispatch body
actionDispatch.description: Hub -> plugin. Everything the plugin needs to execute and report, including the deadline it must discard the action after.

code.description: The declared action code, already validated against the server's manifest.

context.description: The context the action targets. Absent means the declared default.

referenceKey.description: The entity within the context, such as a platform player id.

params.description: Already validated against the schema the manifest declared for this code; a plugin may trust the shape.

expiresAt.description: The action's deadline. A plugin receiving the dispatch after this moment MUST discard it.

actionAck.title: action.ack body
actionAck.description: Plugin -> hub, sent on receipt. Moves the action to running.

actionResult.title: action.result body
actionResult.description: Plugin -> hub, sent when execution finished. `ok` decides the terminal state: completed or failed.

result.description: Arbitrary JSON up to 64 KiB, measured on the raw bytes of the serialized value; null or absent when there is nothing to report. Over the cap, the hub keeps the outcome, drops the payload, and notes the drop in error.

error.description: Human-readable failure description; null or absent when ok is true. Bounded by the hub (reference cap 4 KiB, truncated beyond it).

durationMs.description: How long execution took on the game server. Optional, advisory; a negative value is dropped as unusable.
